parsed.name: Linkam SDK封装组件
parsed.description: 一个非实体的软件组件，用于初始化和管理 Linkam SDK，配置日志，并通过 USB 或 RS-232 与 Linkam 仪器建立连接。它还提供底层消息处理接口，便于实验控制软件调用厂商 SDK 与设备通信。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component that initializes and manages the Linkam SDK, configures logging, and establishes USB or RS-232 connections to Linkam instruments. It also provides low-level message-processing interfaces so laboratory control software can communicate with devices through the vendor SDK.

actions.description: 初始化并打开 Linkam SDK 以供使用。

actions.description_en: Send a message to the Linkam SDK and decode the returned string response.
